name: shanmen_continuous_map
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one continuous 1920x1080 game-world background covering FOUR 960x540 camera screens (two wide by two tall) for an original Chinese wuxia ARPG. Same art style as the attached approved mountain-temple master image, same weathered Chinese architecture, stone, wood, pine and warm dusk palette. The reference is for STYLE AND MATERIALS; create an expanded playable level layout, do not copy its single courtyard, do not include its monk. Top-down 3/4 orthographic camera about45 degrees, no perspective vanishing point, not30-degree isometric, no cinematic sky or horizon. Uniform world scale everywhere on the whole map: a player will be40 native pixels tall; paving slabs about32 native pixels, doorway passable width about100-130 native pixels, gatehouse roof about450-550 native pixels wide. Layout is critical: UPPER HALF is the spacious EMPTY practice courtyard INSIDE Ciyun temple, flat gray-green flagstones with a large clear combat area, rear and side boundary walls along the far edges, only sparse pines/rocks at outside edges. LOWER HALF is the approach OUTSIDE the temple, with broad stone stairs, a ruined gatehouse and blank plaque, two stone lions with the RIGHT lion visibly broken, one toppled green-bronze incense burner at the side, cracked paving and pines framing edges. A continuous perimeter wall with the gatehouse in its MIDDLE runs across the map near its HORIZONTAL MIDLINE, separating inside/north from outside/south. The gatehouse must NOT sit at the top of the image: the entire upper courtyard must be visible above and behind it. The weathered wooden gate doors are open against their side jambs, leaving a clearly visible unobstructed central passage that connects the lower approach up the stairs THROUGH the gate into the upper practice courtyard. Gatehouse roof and side-wall tile eaves should have a clean readable silhouette so they can later become a foreground occlusion layer. Keep the gatehouse near x=960 and y=560 in the native1920x1080 map. Wide clear floor on BOTH sides of the gate, central entrance at bottom-center; avoid stairs or rocks blocking that approach. This is a functional continuous overhead level map, not two separate panels, no seam, no duplicated gate or additional building in the middle of the practice arena. Required materials: warm upper-left dusk light #C9A66B, gray-green stone #6E6A5E, dark wooden gate #3B2A20, deep night-blue shadows #1C2233, muted pine greens #4C6B55, a small bronze-green #5E8F7A incense burner. Hard two-step shading and sharp large pixel clusters, at most48 environment colors, restrained textures, no outlines on ground/walls, no gradients, antialiasing, blur, bloom, photorealism or3D. No people, NPCs, monks, silhouettes, animals, UI, written characters, letters, text, watermark or logos; every plaque is completely blank. No magic effects or warning circles. No wooden crates, wine jars or torches on playable ground; these are separate interactive sprites in the project, leave edge space for them to be placed later. No Japanese elements, torii or palace/dragon decoration. Return ONE full opaque 16:9 map, preferably3840x2160 as an exact2x working image for the final1920x1080 grid, without border, labels, annotations or split-screen frames.
